current_grouping: 20. AERIAL DELIVERY: AIR TRANSPORT AND AIRDROP

versions.grouping_at_time: 20. AERIAL DELIVERY: AIR TRANSPORT AND AIRDROP
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's cargo restraint system meets the air transportability requirements in the principal directions IAW MIL-STD-1366, Cargo Restraint Requirements paragraph for the cargo and payload capacity of the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review air vehicle capabilities documents, cargo system design data packages, and air transportability requirements to ensure air vehicle, cargo, and payload have defined tiedown provisions. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct loads and strength analysis to verify the defined provisions can restrain entire cargo and payload to meet aerial delivery requirements Demonstration.
    (1) Conduct a ground demonstration to verify cargo and payload restraint provisions can be anchored to the air vehicle cargo system without interference. Test.
      (1) Ground or Lab test: Perform crash hazard acceleration testing to verify tiedown provision restraint system will withstand forces required to secure the cargo and payload IAW MIL-STD- 1791, Verification Methods paragraph. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
      (2) Ground or Lab test: Simulate load on tiedown provision restraints to meet aerial delivery requirements.
